title: Interactive output
idea: Interactive output: A small real input controls a generous output region, with a concise statement of what changed.
audience: People who need to try output within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: A bounded demonstration can honestly show the product effect.
avoidWhen: The result would require simulating unavailable backend intelligence.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its try output priority and explicit commitment contract: Label sample processing and avoid implying the demonstration saved or delivered anything.

imagery.role: Support the actual try output context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.

responsiveRules: Put input and output in one clear phone sequence with a stable loading region.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the interactive output structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no try output content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Label sample processing and avoid implying the demonstration saved or delivered anything.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized try output content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Label sample processing and avoid implying the demonstration saved or delivered anything.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active try output context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.
